meta.name: n8n-automation
meta.description: Trigger and manage n8n workflows via webhooks and API. Use when you need to automate complex multi-step processes, integrate external services, or trigger workflows programmatically. Works with self-hosted n8n (free) or n8n cloud.

copy.tagline: 通过 API 触发和管理 n8n 工作流
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要编程方式触发或管理 n8n 自动化流程
copy.tagline_en: Trigger and manage n8n workflows via API
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to programmatically trigger or manage n8n automation workflows

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以通过 webhook 或 API 触发和管理 n8n 工作流，实现多步骤自动化任务，如发送通知、处理数据等。
howto.when: 当你需要自动化复杂流程、集成外部服务（如 Slack、Email、数据库等）或通过脚本触发工作流时，Claude 会接管并调用 n8n。

say.text: 帮我触发 n8n 工作流，发送一条 Slack 通知。
say.note: Claude 会调用 webhook 触发对应工作流。

say.text: 用 n8n 处理这个 JSON 数据并存入数据库。
say.note: Claude 会通过 API 执行数据处理工作流。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can trigger and manage n8n workflows via webhook or API, enabling multi-step automation tasks like sending notifications or processing data.
howto.when_en: When you need to automate complex processes, integrate external services (e.g., Slack, Email, database), or trigger workflows programmatically, Claude will take over and call n8n.

say_en.text: Trigger an n8n workflow to send a Slack notification.
say_en.note: Claude will call the webhook to trigger the workflow.

say_en.text: Process this JSON data with n8n and save to database.
say_en.note: Claude will execute the data processing workflow via API.
